counting_policy.partial_sum: C stays in logical VMEM across K; read/write once per K block, first block has no old-C read
counting_policy.input_access: one logical input read per block at aggregate matrix service; no MXU fanout model
counting_policy.accumulation: INT32 project workload convention; native TPU numerical semantics unverified
counting_policy.scratch: only A/B/C logical storage; runtime, register spills and packing workspace not modeled

interconnect_specification.topology: 3D mesh; full cubes can form 3D torus or supported twisted torus slices
interconnect_specification.conditions: Specification only; no links, routing or collectives are executed. Link direction and effective payload bandwidth remain unverified.

clock_hz.conditions: Reference clock; not an effective instruction rate.

tensorcores_per_chip.conditions: Architectural inventory; the counter uses one TensorCore.

mxus_per_tensorcore.conditions: Inventory only; no assignment to individual MXUs.

mxu_rows.conditions: Physical matrix geometry, not a logical-block alignment rule.

mxu_columns.conditions: Physical matrix geometry, not a logical-block alignment rule.

int8_macs_per_cell_cycle.conditions: Geometry-based peak assumption consistent with published approximately 275 TOPS; not an effective rate or cycle model.

nominal_int8_tops.conditions: Official table labels bf16 or int8 as 275 teraflops; INT8 is reported here as TOPS with 2 operations per MAC.

vpus_per_tensorcore.conditions: Vector unit inventory, not executed by the counter.

vpu_lanes.conditions: ALU inventory does not specify operation throughput.

vpu_alus_per_lane.conditions: Do not convert ALU count to a per-op effective rate.

vector_int32_adds_per_cycle.source: ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-parameters: parameter gaps in the cited TPU v4 paper and product documentation
vector_int32_adds_per_cycle.conditions: Operation-specific INT32 add rate has not been established.

vector_fp32_ops_per_cycle.source: ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-parameters: parameter gaps in the cited TPU v4 paper and product documentation
vector_fp32_ops_per_cycle.conditions: FP32 instruction mix and throughput have not been established.

scalar_ops_per_cycle.source: ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-parameters: parameter gaps in the cited TPU v4 paper and product documentation
scalar_ops_per_cycle.conditions: Scalar instruction throughput has not been established.

sfu_units_per_tensorcore.source: ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-parameters: parameter gaps in the cited TPU v4 paper and product documentation
sfu_units_per_tensorcore.conditions: Presence and inventory of a separate nonlinear/SFU unit have not been established; unknown is not not-applicable or zero.

sfu_fp32_ops_per_cycle.source: ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-parameters: parameter gaps in the cited TPU v4 paper and product documentation
sfu_fp32_ops_per_cycle.conditions: Nonlinear operation-specific throughput has not been established.

vmem_usable_bytes.conditions: Logical scenario allows the full reference VMEM for A/B/C; runtime reservations, packing and spills are not modeled. Not a measured allocatable capacity.

vmem_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.source: ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-parameters: parameter gaps in the cited TPU v4 paper and product documentation
vmem_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.conditions: Effective read/write service and port sharing have not been established.

cmem_physical_bytes.source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2304.01433 (PDF p2, section 2 opening paragraphs; PDF p7, Table 4)
cmem_physical_bytes.conditions: Shared scratchpad counted once per chip, not a transparent cache.

cmem_usable_bytes.source: ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-parameters: parameter gaps in the cited TPU v4 paper and product documentation
cmem_usable_bytes.conditions: No CMEM allocation or execution in this counter; usable capacity not established.

cmem_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.source: ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-parameters: parameter gaps in the cited TPU v4 paper and product documentation
cmem_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.conditions: CMEM effective service bandwidth has not been established.

smem_physical_bytes.source: ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-parameters: parameter gaps in the cited TPU v4 paper and product documentation
smem_physical_bytes.conditions: A target-specific scalar-memory physical capacity has not been established from the selected references.

register_file_physical_bytes.source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2304.01433 (PDF p7, Table 4; PDF p10, section 7.5)
register_file_physical_bytes.conditions: Table 4 and section 7.5 identify 0.25 MiB register file per chip. Distribution/ownership per TensorCore is not established; do not divide chip inventory by two. Chip total is recorded in calibration/parameter_source_audit.json.

spmem_physical_bytes.conditions: Aggregate SparseCore memory; unavailable to dense GEMM working blocks.

hbm_physical_bytes.conditions: Unified physical HBM2 capacity; 32 GiB, not 32 decimal GB.

hbm_usable_bytes.conditions: Logical scenario allocates up to physical HBM; real runtime reserves memory. A/B/C coexist, no host offload. Not a measured runtime limit.

hbm_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.conditions: Published aggregate bandwidth, decimal GB/s; no inference of single-TensorCore effective bandwidth.

ici_links_per_chip.conditions: Inventory only; mesh/torus selection depends on the slice.

ici_link_reported_bytes_per_second.conditions: Reported 50 GB/s/link; directional interpretation is unresolved in this profile. Do not use as one-way payload bandwidth.

ici_link_one_way_bytes_per_second.source: ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-parameters: parameter gaps in the cited TPU v4 paper and product documentation
ici_link_one_way_bytes_per_second.conditions: One-way effective payload bandwidth is not established; no aggregate bidirectional throughput is derived.

process_node_nm.conditions: Reported process node; no technology scaling model.

die_area_upper_bound_mm2.conditions: Strict upper bound: die area <600 mm2; neither exact area nor a component area coefficient.

limitations: Chip hardware hierarchy and inventory; single-TensorCore logical counts only.
Private VMEM totals are inventory, not pooled usable capacity; shared resources are counted once.
Chip peaks are specification arithmetic; no multi-TensorCore scheduling or count scaling.
No hardware padding, physical transactions, numerical simulation or compiler mapping.
No MXU placement, weight residency, CMEM execution, VPU/SFU execution or timing.
Action coverage is partial; unknown internal activity is not treated as zero.
Transfer summaries overlap endpoint actions; do not charge both in an energy model.
